storage: Store at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture.
definition: Tesamorelin + Ipamorelin Blend (TP) is a multi-component peptide blend supplied as white lyophilized powder. The catalogue lists 6 pack sizes: 8 mg, 10 mg, 13 mg, 15 mg, 15 mg, 17 mg. The CAS number, full sequence and molecular weight are recorded in the lot-specific certificate of analysis (COA). Component ratios follow the specification printed on each vial label. Purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC) with white lyophilized powder appearance. For laboratory research use only; not for human or veterinary use.

faq.question: How is Tesamorelin + Ipamorelin Blend tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: Each lot of Tesamorelin + Ipamorelin Blend is analysed by HPLC for purity and by mass spectrometry for identity. The lot-specific certificate of analysis reports the measured purity, retention time, molecular mass and appearance. Catalogue purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC).

faq.question: How should Tesamorelin + Ipamorelin Blend be stored?
faq.answer: Store the lyophilized powder at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture. After reconstitution, keep the solution at 2-8 °C and use it within the period stated in the lot certificate of analysis. Avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles. This product is for laboratory research use only.

faq.question: What pack sizes are available for Tesamorelin + Ipamorelin Blend?
faq.answer: Tesamorelin + Ipamorelin Blend is available in 6 configurations: 8 mg, 10 mg, 13 mg, 15 mg, 15 mg, 17 mg. Each kit contains 10 vials. Minimum order quantity is 1 kit. Volume pricing applies to 10-49 kits and 50+ kits.
